evidence.scope: Give the clarified question criteria that tell a question nobody has answered from one only the work can settle, and prove the change on records already written, including one that should still be refused.
acceptance: The criteria say a record is clarified when everything answerable by reading, deciding or asking has been answered, and anything only the work can settle is named with the observation that will settle it: evidenced by the question definition
Genuine records rise: SEEN-096 from 0.65 to 0.79, SEEN-088 from 0.64 to 0.74, SEEN-091 from 0.84 to 0.88, unchanged apart from the criteria
Thin and vague records stay refused, at 0.50 and 0.44, so the gap between a record worth working from and one that is not widens from 0.19 to 0.29
The before and after scores for all four records are in the journal: evidenced by the note
The skill tells a session to name what only the work can settle rather than leave it out: evidenced by docs/harness/skill.md and its regenerated copies
The threshold is untouched at 0.8: evidenced by thresholds.toml

The unit tests assert the shape rather than the model's behaviour, and the measurement in the journal is what verifies the effect: evidenced by the tests and by the note, because no test may call the API
decisions: The criteria text, measured rather than assumed. The question stays as it is and the true criterion widens: 'Every open question is answered or explicitly deferred with a decision. A question that only doing the work can settle counts as resolved when the record names what will settle it.' The false criterion becomes: 'Something material is still unresolved, with no decision and nothing said about what would resolve it.'
A first candidate was discarded because the measurement refuted it: putting the caveat into the question lowered every score, SEEN-096 0.65 to 0.49 and SEEN-088 0.64 to 0.39. Recorded at the note

The control is a record that is thin throughout rather than one decision short: SEEN-096 minus one decision scored 0.65 against the original's 0.65, and the question was right not to notice. A thin record scores 0.50 and a vague one 0.44 under the new criteria, both refused

The before-scores were measured today against the current criteria rather than taken from the journals, because the records were judged at different times and the comparison has to hold everything else still: SEEN-096 0.65, SEEN-088 0.63, SEEN-091 0.83
SEEN-091 is in the set as a record that already scored well, to show the change does not simply raise everything

A fourth record is written as a control, deliberately leaving a material question open, and it must still be refused. Without it the acceptance criteria could be satisfied by making the gate permissive
The threshold stays at 0.8. It has cleared five times today on records that genuinely resolved things, so the bar is doing real work and the question is what was asking wrongly
This is the second question corrected rather than recalibrated, after solution_complete in SEEN-006, and both changed the criteria rather than the number

The control is a real clarify record kept as a test fixture in harness/tests, not a passing remark: it copies SEEN-096's record and removes the no-hook decision entirely, leaving the question of how the tool stays current unmentioned. It must still score below 0.8
The measurement is a script in the journal rather than numbers typed into a note: the four records are re-asked in one run, before and after, and its output is the note, so anyone can repeat it

How the change is verified, given that no test may call the model: the unit tests assert the shape, that the question carries both criteria and that the threshold is untouched, and the behaviour is verified by the recorded measurement in the journal, which anyone can repeat with the script that produced it. A test that called Jev would spend money and answer differently on different days, which is the rule SEEN-088 established when it sealed the suite off from the API.
graph_impact: harness/jev.py holds the question definitions, and the criteria are one entry in it
